summary: ADV-8 is closed: 98c2713d3 made the loader extension-agnostic and flags Markdown-like non-.md files by name. A new false pass remains: an uppercase .MD post is never parsed and never flagged, so it escapes all 17 cases; isolated, the suite is green with only an uppercase .MD post present. The no-extension, .markdown, and new-locale-folder probes fail and name the file. The -segments.json allowance holds as designed. ADV-11 routes to Green with a committed failing test.
blocking_findings: ADV-11 [Blocker] adversarial: an uppercase .MD post escapes the merged blog validation. loadAllPosts parses only files ending exactly ".md" (case-sensitive), and the mislabelled sweep of blog-posts-validation.test.ts uses MARKDOWN_LIKE_RE /\.(?:mdx|markdown|mdown|mkd)$/i, which omits a plain .md stem and so misses .MD; the no-extension branch needs a dot, which the file has. A valid post saved as th/ZZ-ADV-UPPER.MD left all 17 cases green at 04e7ff8a8 (isolated run: 17 passed with only that file present). Route-to-Green: flag a case-insensitive .md suffix that is not exactly ".md" (for example /\.md$/i.test(ref) && !ref.endsWith(".md")). The committed probe src/__tests__/blog-posts-loader.adversarial.test.tsx fails its new ADV-11 case until the fix lands.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-8 closed: 98c2713d3 added fixtures/blog-posts-loader.ts, which lists every non-hidden regular file per locale directory and parses only .md files; the extension rule and both discovery-adjacent cases flag Markdown-like non-.md files by name. A temporary en/zz-adv-probe.mdx and th/zz-adv-probe.markdown were each named in three failing cases. The committed mdx probe passes 1 of 1.
ADV-9 kept: the R2 rewrites catch the old class-pin mutations (recorded at 8f7d94961).
ADV-10 kept: the merged rules name offenders and empty discovery fails loudly (recorded at 8f7d94961).

ADV-12 [Note] adversarial: the -segments.json allowance holds as designed. A temporary en/zz-adv-segments.json holding post-shaped frontmatter was neither parsed nor flagged, so a post hidden behind that name escapes every rule; real -segments.json data companions stay ignored as intended. A post behind .json never reaches production (the blog lib reads .md only). Optional hardening: validate that -segments.json files parse as JSON and carry no frontmatter.
evidence: At 04e7ff8a8 the probe file and src/lib/blog-posts-validation.test.ts pass: 2 files, 18 tests.

With en/zz-adv-noext, en/zz-adv-probe.mdx, th/zz-adv-probe.markdown, and ja/zz-adv-ja-post.md (missing title) present, the validation named en/zz-adv-noext, en/zz-adv-probe.mdx, and th/zz-adv-probe.markdown in three cases and ja/zz-adv-ja-post in the title rule.
Isolated run with only th/ZZ-ADV-UPPER.MD present: 17 passed, 17 failed none, proving the uppercase .MD post is invisible.
A temporary en/zz-adv-segments.json with frontmatter content was invisible to all cases and was not named in any failure.
Every temporary file and the ja directory were deleted; git status is clean before the probe commit.
The committed probe at 4de4b39ff fails the ADV-11 case and passes the mdx case; its temp files self-clean.
